Name: Beautified Maru
Author: Moe1990
Description:
I just did a little rework for Maru because although i did like the character, i didnt really like her looks...so ive changed it a bit and thought i share it :)

I've kept the vanilla style mostly, so it shouldnt look to out of place :3
...Oh yeah and i skimpyfied her a little bit, just liked it better so...there you go ;)

To install just drag and drop the content of the "stardew valley" folder in the archive into your stardew valley folder on your pc..

Downloads.Description: Drag and drop into you stardew valley folder
